whenToUse: Confirming irreversible or high-stakes actions: delete workspace, cancel subscription, revoke access.
One-line confirmations from code with useConfirm().
avoidWhen: Reversible actions — do it immediately and offer Undo in a Toast.
Forms or multi-field tasks — use Dialog.
Informational messages — use Alert or Toast.
a11y: role=alertdialog with title and description wired; the overlay never dismisses it.
Danger tone focuses Cancel first; name the object in the title (Delete “Spring menu”?).
